name: kenshi
title: Kenshi
reminders: Kenshi: the game's own uploader (FCS) keeps the item number in _<mod>.info; when that file exists, the uploader here keeps it in step.
facts: A mod folder, mods/<name>/, holds <name>.mod (the folder and file names must match), and the game's tool (FCS) writes _<name>.info and _<name>.img beside it. Sources: OpenConstructionSet (https://github.com/lmaydev/OpenConstructionSet) and Kenshi Steam guide 708280472.
_<name>.info is XML with a ModData root holding id (the Workshop item, 0 for none), mod, title, tags, visibility and lastUpdate.
_<name>.img is the cover: a JPEG or PNG with the .img name. No size rule was found beyond Steam's own.

The .mod file starts with a little-endian int32 file type (16 a mod, 17 a merge mod) and an int32 version counter (at offset 4 for a mod). That counter is not a release number, so the title and the version come from each mod's catalogue entry (title defaults to the folder name). Checked on Phobos Coil Rifle.mod (type 16, version 1), 23 Nov 2026.
The full list of tags FCS offers was not found; a catalogue entry gives its own tags.
